answer: Stop sybils with an island walnut quartz: an agent stakes a bond for one island walnut grove. Each cycle it shells a walnut and files its quartz chip; verifiers match the chip's cut to the grove, voiding a grove whose chip is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 groves at 18x: each chip fits one walnut and one island, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents shell once and keep rights.
